question: What inner structures are affected when the yogin slightly opens the mouth of awareness?
premises: The yogin slightly opens the mouth of awareness.
All inner circles connected with senses and channels depend on this opening.
Their traversal is activated by that opening.
inference: A slight opening of the mouth of awareness activates all inner circles and channels of the senses.
uncertainties: The referent of sarvā is syntactically compressed; taken as all the cakra-structures implied by the compound.
plain_english: When the yogin slightly opens the mouth of awareness, all the inner circles of the senses and channels, resting on that traversal, are activated.
